verdict.rationale: Blink's source is public on GitHub (blinksh/blink), and the repo invites users to download, build and install Blink themselves through Xcode. Community users describe an open-source process and note you can compile it yourself for free. However, no evidence item names the actual license or states its terms, so the 'open license' part rests on community characterization. Missing for 10: explicit first-party license identification (e.g., the license name/LICENSE file), documented license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
